འཁྲུལ་པ is logical deviation/inconstancy (vyabhicāra): 'because the deviation is the same'.

errors.english: One must infer this because a definite effect is seen at all times.
errors.why: The whole གལ་ཏེ... clause through 'because it has a definite specific cooperating factor' is the anticipated objection introduced by 'But the effect', not the commentator's own assertion.

errors.english: it is not so, thus the objection is raised

note: Follows the commentary's lemma structure but misreads several grammatical glosses and blurs the line between objection and reply.

errors.english: have not been made allowable so that the sprouts can come forth

errors.english: When explaining pots and so forth

errors.english: [note: reincarnation or continuous rebirth of similar moments]

errors.english: smoke and so forth are to those very fires
